name: PhiUSIIL Phishing URL Dataset
source: UCI Machine Learning Repository, dataset id 967
citation: Prasad, A. and Chandra, S. (2024). PhiUSIIL: A diverse, large-scale dataset for phishing URL detection. Computers & Security. DOI 10.1016/j.cose.2023.103545.
label_meaning: label == 1 is a legitimate URL, label == 0 is a phishing URL (confirmed directly against the real downloaded file, not assumed from documentation)
note: The raw CSV (54 MB) is not committed to this repository; data_raw/ is gitignored. scripts/fetch_dataset.py re-downloads it and verifies zip_sha256 above against this exact file.
